title: Cyber extensions
description: Private authorized-lab security extension surface. It is separate from the normal desktop dashboard and is exposed only in a private build with the feature flag on.

authorization.banner: AUTHORIZED USE ONLY. Use this surface only on systems you own or for which you hold explicit, written permission. Define an explicit target scope before running any tool, and stop and clear the scope when finished.
authorization.acknowledgement: I have explicit written authorization that names the in-scope systems and time window.
authorization.labConfirmationLabel: I confirm this Nmap scan targets an authorized lab or private network.
authorization.setConfirmationLabel: I confirm this SET launch is limited to systems I own or am explicitly authorized in writing to test.
authorization.dualUseWarning: SET is a dual-use social-engineering framework. Use it only on systems you own or are explicitly authorized in writing to test. Phishing, credential harvesting, and payload delivery are prohibited.
authorization.targetScopeLabel: Target scope (owned or explicitly authorized only)

tabs.title: Nmap
tabs.description: Explicit, operator-started network mapping for an authorized target scope.

tool.installHint: Nmap is part of the reviewed core image. If it is missing, install it from the reviewed package source or work without this tab.

tabs.title: SET
tabs.description: Social-Engineer Toolkit launcher/status panel. SET is dual-use. This tab detects an operator-installed SET and launches it only after an explicit, authorized-lab confirmation; it bundles and generates no targets, templates, phishing pages, credential harvesters, or payloads.

policy.reason: SET is admitted only as an operator-installed, explicitly confirmed dual-use launcher. This frontend ships no attack content and generates no target, template, phishing page, credential harvester, or payload.

tool.installHint: SET is not shipped in this image. If an operator-installed copy is present, this tab detects it through the host probe; otherwise no command is run. Adding SET to the image requires a separate policy review.

tabs.title: Wireshark / Forensics
tabs.description: Capture-file inspection and forensic review. No capture starts automatically.

tool.installHint: Wireshark and the forensic baseline are part of the reviewed core image. Open only captures you own or are authorized to examine.

tabs.title: Lab / VM
tabs.description: Isolated VM launcher for authorized lab work. No VM, bridge, or service starts by itself.

tool.installHint: The isolated QEMU/libvirt lab baseline is part of the reviewed core image. Keep lab traffic inside a network you own and control.
